items.label: Include
items.content:
# Step 1: Include the AIClient Library

**Essence:**
Include the AIClient script in your HTML to make the library available globally.

**Code:**
```html
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/HyperRushNet/hrn-ai/client/1.0.3.min.js"></script>
```

items.label: API Key
items.content:
# Step 2: Set Your API Key

**Essence:**
Authenticate your client using your unique API key.

**Code:**
```javascript
client.setApiKey('YOUR_API_KEY');
```

items.label: Type
items.content:
# Step 3: Choose Type

**Essence:**
Decide whether you want text or image output.

**Text Example:**
```javascript
client.setType('text');
```

**Image Example:**
```javascript
client.setType('image');
```

items.label: Model
items.content:
# Step 4: Set Model

**Essence:**
Choose the model best suited for your task. You can check model options and health:
- [Models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/#:~:text=Models)
- [Model Health](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai/)

**Code Example:**
```javascript
client.setModel('flux'); // default is 'flux'
```
